title: Atomic‐Scale Insights Into the Thermal Stability of High‐Entropy Nanoalloys

recollection.results: guess: improved thermal stability, phase transitions, or enhanced properties

score.note: The recollection only generically identifies heating, possible core-shell structure, and diffusion/segregation. It omits the specific in situ 298–973 K heating, initial FCC multi-twinned/icosahedral structure, Au/Cu surface segregation driven by surface-energy minimization, melting/evaporation, and the 22% size reduction. Its suggestion of improved thermal stability is opposite to the observed poor stability.
